title: J, K, L
summary: Learn J, K, L, then practise with the keys you already know.
intro: Learn J, K, L, then practise with the keys you already know.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press j to type J. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: Jff fJfJ JJf JJJ JJ Jff JJff fJ ffJJ

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press k to type K. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: KKK KjjK KK KKKK jKKK KKKj jjj KKj jjK KKjK jKK jK

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press l to type L. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: LLfL LLf fLL Lf ffLf LLL LL LLLf LLLL ff Lff fLfL

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
screens.content: KK JJ JKLJ LJnL nKJK JJKJ LK LJKK KLK KL KKKK

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
